rights_basis: Faithful bounded reading transcription of original-language liturgical text from Ketābā de-qurbānā (Beirut Maronite Press, 1908 second printing of Dibs 1888) — Anaphora of the Twelve Apostles Core, whose United States copyright term has expired by publication date (1908 (second printing of Dibs 1888)). Derived directly from tracked public-domain facsimile artifact.maronite-church.qurbono.1908-beirut-maronite-press-second-printing.pages-0224-0447-5b0fbb00 without modern translation or editorial reconstruction. text: ܒܝܘܡܐ ܗܘ ܕܩܕܡ ܚܫܐ ܕܝܠܗ ܢܣܒ ܠܠܚܡܐ ܒܐܝܕܘܗܝ ܩܕܝܫܬܐ ܘܐܪܝܡ ܥܝܢܘܗܝ ܠܘܬܟ ܐܠܗܐ ܐܒܘܗܝ ܐܚܝܕ ܟܠ ܘܐܘܕܝ ܠܟ ܘܒܪܟ ܘܩܕܫ ܘܩܨܐ ܘܝܗܒ ܠܬܠܡܝܕܘܗܝ ܟܕ ܐܡܪ ܣܒܘ ܐܟܘܠܘ ܡܢܗ ܟܠܟܘܢ ܗܢܐ ܕܝܢ ܐܝܬܘܗܝ ܦܓܪܐ ܕܝܠܝ ܐܡܝܢ
